staticArtwork.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, color palette replacement only.
Edit this approved 1983 x 793 Daily Deposit Bonus static banner. Change ONLY its cool teal accent color from green/teal to ICE MIST BLUE #A8D8E8. Treat #A8D8E8 as the exact target accent hue family, with darker blue-gray shadows and luminous pale-blue highlights.
Recolor all teal background illumination and blurred atmosphere, the clean concentric light rings behind the woman, and teal edge reflections/extrusion edges around the gold lettering, chest and character to this cool sophisticated ice-mist blue. The dark left background should become deep smoky midnight blue rather than green; the halo should read as pale ice blue, not turquoise or saturated electric blue. Warm bokeh remains warm champagne.
Preserve EVERYTHING else exactly: the short-haired modern adult woman, her face, pose, hands, burgundy tailored jacket, open red-and-gold chest with the Jito emblem, gold coins, rubies, sharp text, full layout and composition. Keep the burgundy #681C32 and champagne gold colors unchanged. No changes to brightness of gold letters or skin.
The exact text must remain in its exact position, size, shapes, style and spacing:
EVERY DAY
DAILY DEPOSIT
BONUS
A new day. A new bonus.
No buttons, no CTA, no new elements, no extra text, no currency or numbers, no watermark. Same 1983 x 793 full-bleed opaque wide canvas. This is a color revision, not a redesign.
